title: Tizen Homebrew Channel program catalog
description: A catalog of C# and native programs that the Tizen Homebrew Channel can install and launch through hbc-srv.

updated.description: ISO-8601 date or timestamp for the catalog revision.

installRoot.description: Directory used by hbc-srv for installed programs.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for relative file, icon and README paths. May be empty for bundled catalogs.

id.description: Stable identifier. It is also the install directory name.

dir.description: Directory name inside the programs repository.

readme.description: README path relative to the program directory (or baseUrl).

language.description: csharp for .NET programs, native for ELF executables.

runtime.description: dotnet runs the entry with the dotnet host; elf executes it directly.

entry.description: Program-relative path to the .dll or ELF executable.

terminal.description: Open the xterm.js 24-bit terminal for this program.

keyboard.description: Open the virtual keyboard automatically after launch.

output.description: terminal shows a PTY; log starts the program without the terminal UI.

icon.description: Icon path relative to baseUrl, or an app-relative path for bundled programs.

bundled.description: Install from hbc-srv's local programs/<id> bundle instead of downloading files.

path.description: Destination path relative to the program install directory.

url.description: Source URL or baseUrl-relative path. Defaults to path.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum verified by hbc-srv.
